decisions.decision: Three lanes: SOURCE_DERIVED_PHYSICAL, PROJECT_BASIS_QTO, BLOCKED_UNQUANTIFIED. PROJECT_BASIS_QTO is never VERIFIED_PHYSICAL or AS_BUILT.
decisions.name: QUANTITY_AUTHORITY_LANES

decisions.decision: N bars/m over W m = N x W equivalent bars, unrounded, no +1, no ceil / floor. PHYSICAL_BBS_BAR_COUNT stays UNRESOLVED unless a project-source count convention exists.
decisions.name: RATE_DENSITY_QTO

decisions.decision: 'NØD' without '/m' is EXPLICIT_COUNT only when bound to a discrete bar group / support-bar graphic / finite reinforcement object. A clear count may release with its length blocked.
decisions.name: EXPLICIT_COUNT_BINDING

decisions.decision: A source-stated 50% continue / 50% stop is an exact 0.5 / 0.5 density split for QTO. Which physical bars stop (and an odd count) stays a BBS question.
decisions.name: FIFTY_PERCENT_DENSITY_SPLIT

decisions.decision: Rules are compared by bar-role identity first. Different families coexist; the same family takes LOCAL / FLOOR-SPECIFIC PLAN NOTE > GENERIC TYPICAL DETAIL, never summed; the loser is OVERRIDDEN_PROJECT_SOURCE. Unresolved identity blocks that top family only.
decisions.name: BAR_ROLE_IDENTITY_FIRST

decisions.decision: Where plan note 2 governs and its origin is not explicit: URBAN_QTO_TOP_OVER_SUPPORT_EXTENT_V1 = 1/3 x CLEAR_SPAN from the SUPPORT FACE into the panel, authority URBAN_OWNER_MEASUREMENT_RULE (not PROJECT_SOURCE_EXPLICIT).
decisions.name: ONE_THIRD_SPAN_BASIS

decisions.decision: 160 mm (and 180 mm): TABLE_NO_EXACT_ROW, BLOCKED_UNQUANTIFIED. A blocked temperature component blocks nothing else.
decisions.name: TEMPERATURE_NO_INTERPOLATION

decisions.decision: The two water-tank panels and their T 18 / local reinforcement go to S8_SPECIAL_STRUCTURE / WATER_TANK_SUPPORT_REGION (ownership transfer, nothing lost).
decisions.name: WATER_TANK_TO_S8

decisions.decision: The light-well / void + stair + T 16 + 8Ø16/m face goes to S8_SPECIAL_STRUCTURE / STAIR_LIGHTWELL_REGION with SOURCE_CONFLICT_PRESERVED.
decisions.name: LIGHTWELL_TO_S8

decisions.decision: Different callouts across a continuous support: LEFT_PANEL_BAR_RUN and RIGHT_PANEL_BAR_RUN to the support face; continuation / lap / splice / development / transition blocked. Nothing chosen by majority, size, rate or nearest value.
decisions.name: MISMATCH_SPLIT

decisions.decision: A local '/Top' callout bound to a support overrides the general top rule for the same role at that location (LOCAL_SOURCE_OVERRIDE / GENERAL_RULE_SUPERSEDED_FOR_ROLE); not additive without evidence of a second family.
decisions.name: LOCAL_TOP_OVERRIDE

decisions.decision: A sunken panel keeps its normal mesh in S7; SUNKEN_STEP_VERTICAL_REBAR, SUNKEN_EDGE_EXTRA and LEVEL_CHANGE_DETAIL are separate and blocked unless specified.
decisions.name: SUNKEN_MESH_RETAINED

decisions.decision: The dense hatch is classified by geometry, not by the hatch: outside the perimeter and attached along one support -> CANTILEVER_CANDIDATE; a strip filling a support band -> BEARING_WALL_CANDIDATE; otherwise CLASSIFICATION_BLOCKED.
decisions.name: DENSE_HATCH_BY_GEOMETRY

decisions.decision: Irregular panels are measured by local bar lines: strips per bar direction, clipped to support faces and openings; the local clear run (and the local L of a span rule) is URBAN_QTO_LOCAL_BAR_LINE_V1. No bounding rectangle.
decisions.name: LOCAL_BAR_LINE_MODEL

decisions.decision: No structural slab beyond (outside, void, open to below, no slab) -> NON_CONTINUOUS; a physical slab beyond that is blocked / special / transferred / at another level / over a non-beam support -> CONTINUITY_UNRESOLVED. Excluded ownership is not physical absence.
decisions.name: PHYSICAL_CONTINUITY

decisions.decision: '40 CL.' and any callout whose binding is not proven stay unresolved; no quantity depends on them; nothing is read from graphic scale.
decisions.name: AMBIGUOUS_CALLOUTS_UNRESOLVED

decisions.decision: 25 mm is MINIMUM_PROJECT_COVER (D1.2). Any quantity using it as a number is PROJECT_BASIS_QTO, never SOURCE_EXACT or AS_BUILT.
decisions.name: MINIMUM_COVER_IS_PROJECT_BASIS

urban_rules.URBAN_QTO_LOCAL_BAR_LINE_V1: local clear run along each bar line; local L for span rules on irregular panels (AD2-D14)
urban_rules.URBAN_QTO_TOP_OVER_SUPPORT_EXTENT_V1: 1/3 x local clear span from the support face into the panel (AD2-D06)
